datasets.name: Aerial photographs of slope failure regions
datasets.verbatim: These images can be viewed and downloaded from a web map site called GSI Map provided by the Geographical Survey Institute (https://maps.gsi.go.jp/ (accessed on 26 July 2022)).

methods.name: Mask R-CNN with CutMix-based augmentation
methods.summary: The authors use Mask R-CNN, an instance segmentation method, to detect slope failure regions from post-disaster aerial photographs. They apply CutMix-based augmentation to the training data to improve detection accuracy, specifically comparing different augmentation patterns to maintain the shape of the slope failure regions.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the Mask R-CNN method is not available.
